title: G-RELEASE publication and exact-tag post-publication proof
summary: Under an exact owner grant, publish only the sealed `1.0.0` split/root refs and releases, then prove consumers resolve the released artifacts.
why: `@plan/knowledge/research-P17-design.json` §10; D97. Publication is externally visible and irreversible; a green local candidate is necessary but not authority.

include: Live pre-write reconciliation; ordered idempotent packet operations; append-only ledger; partial resume; exact-tag public/private install; released digest match; final phase receipt.
exclude: Undeclared repository/registry; repository creation or visibility change; secret provisioning; force/delete/rewrite; version substitution; product repair; live customer migration.

rules: Run as `manual`. Materialize owner invocation and verify the grant binds the current packet digest. Follow the exact order/forward-only constraints in §10. Before every operation re-read state; only absent or byte-identical no-op is allowed. Never log credentials.
guidance: Extend the existing exact publisher rather than add a second release engine. Persist an fsynced append-only result before moving to the next operation. On interruption reconcile ledger and remote state, then resume the same packet; mismatch stops.

validation.procedure: Dry-run and synthetic partial-resume tests green before live work. Live ledger has one terminal result per packet operation and no unknown/collision. Fresh consumers install exact `1.0.0` tags on applicable profiles and match candidate archive/tree digests. Root tag/release note and split refs agree; G-RELEASE provenance is present.

deliverables: Immutable split/root `1.0.0` publication, complete append-only ledger, exact-tag consumer proof and terminal P17 phase receipt.
